asked: # Build: requests-ledger (Current profile) - every single thing Brett asked for, in one list ## What Brett said (verbatim, Nov 4 2026, voice) "I need a way to see all the little things I've asked for, like a list of all these things I've asked for, and then when I open it up, it expands into a row. I need to be able to see verbatim what I said that initiated it. And where it is in line, and what its status is, and all that stuff. So I need a way to view every single little thing that I've asked for in a list that expands to all its information regarding its list and the queue, or whatever list it's in, or whatever its status is. I need a hook to access every piece of information about that particular request." Book to a free named agent (Conrad - librarian - if his card exists, else Reel Rhonda). Register id `requests-ledger` in the `current` profile + banner entry + What Brett said block. Steps through the store. ## Do - s1 **One request record** (`request@1`): every distinct ask Brett makes = one row, including **addenda** (each addendum in a build brief is its own request linked to its parent build), planner ideas, bugs, follow-ups, memory 'to do after the freeze' items, crew/HR changes. Fields: verbatim words (exact), when, source (voice/chat/console), who captured it (Amber/session), kind (build / addendum / bug / plan / follow-up / setting / crew), **where it lives now** (build id + step, bug id, plan id, follow-up file), status (idea / planned / queued / running / paused / built-awaiting-merge / merged / live / dropped / superseded - with what superseded it), **queue position** (agent-slots), assigned agent, PR, cost so far, last update. - s2 **Backfill** from everything that exists: builds store `origin.said` + addenda in every `/root/axf-builds/*/.brief.md` ('Brett said' lines), planner plans, follow-ups.md + vision.md + naming.md on axHub (shared memory), bugs (bugs-board when it lands), THREADS. Dedupe; mark Brett's reversals (e.g. 'leave it as filters', 'don't rename axHub') as superseding the earlier ask. - s3 **UI = upgrade the existing Build Breaker plugin** ('Everything you asked for, one line each') into the ledger (don't make a second plugin): one line per request (short title, status chip, queue #, agent avatar, age); tap = **expands into a full row** with the verbatim quote, all linked info, history timeline, and **hooks**: Open build / Open step / Open PR / Open bug / Open plan / Jump to queue / Open log / Talk to agent. Search, filter (status, kind, profile, app, date), sort, group by build/status. Live updates (status/queue changes stream in). Banner count of open requests. Home card. - s4 **Capture going forward**: build_start, brief addenda (tmux addendum pattern), planner adds, bugs-board, memory follow-ups all write a request record automatically (zero tokens). REST + MCP + CLI: requests_list, request_get, request_update, request_link. Amber/sessions use request_get to answer 'where's that thing I asked for'. - Tests/type-check, phone + desktop screenshots filed to UI Review (non-blocking), PR -> merges when CI green, redeploy console. Never leave tsc/vite/playwright running. Report `_claude/builds/reports/requests-ledger.md`. Commits clean and professional. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once. Model switches (Brett, Nov 3 2026): a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine.
